headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
Top MLB News
The Baltimore Orioles have transferred left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. Akin was initially placed on the 15-day injured list. The Pittsburgh Pirates made a midseason roster move by trading RHP Cam Sanders to the Baltimore Orioles for cash on July 13, 2026.

Injuries and Availability Impact
Several players have been placed on the injured list in recent days. The Arizona Diamondbacks placed RHP Zac Gallen on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. The Texas Rangers placed RHP Chris Martin on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder impingement. The Cincinnati Reds placed LHP Nick Lodolo on the 15-day injured list due to a blister on his left index finger. The Miami Marlins placed RHP William Kempner on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow sprain. The Milwaukee Brewers transferred RHP Brandon Woodruff from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Atlanta Braves placed LF Mike Yastrzemski on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins transferred LHP Anthony Banda from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left lat strain.

Trades and Roster Movement
The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Cam Sanders to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers acquired SS Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
